fact: At the 8 October 2025 workshop the ADN reported 58% realisation of the Plan National du Numérique Horizon 2025 (40 of 69 projects started, 17 finished), blamed the Treasury funding deficit, and cited a presidential pledge of USD 1 billion over five years alongside the World Bank USD 400 million and AFD EUR 100 million.
title: RDC : L'ADN présente le bilan de la mise en oeuvre du Plan National du Numérique Horizon 2025
